history.question: Which client has the most projects?
history.answer:
**Acme Corp** leads all clients with a total of **3 projects**. No other client has more projects than Acme Corp based on the current data.

[Source: SQL Agent | SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.id) AS project_count
FROM clients c
JOIN projects p ON p.client_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY project_count DESC
LIMIT 1;]
